visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and grey trousers, stands in a brightly lit department store cosmetics section. He holds a black microphone and points toward the camera with a smiling, energetic expression. Behind him are glowing brand signs for CHANTECAILLE and KOSE. (2) A close-up shot features a silver jar of CHANTECAILLE Bio Lifting Mask+ held by a hand. The background is a soft-focus view of the retail environment. (3) The man stands next to a male staff member in a black suit. They are at a counter filled with skincare products and floral decorations. Both men are smiling and gesturing towards the items. (4) A close-up shows a small metal spatula scooping a thick white cream from the jar and spreading it onto the man's tattooed hand. (5) The man holds a frosted pink bottle of Pure Rosewater, pointing to its label while speaking to the camera. (6) He closes his eyes and sprays the fine mist from the rosewater bottle onto his face, with the overhead studio lighting highlighting the water droplets. (7) A glass jar of Chantecaille foundation is presented in a close-up, followed by a demo of a brush applying the beige liquid to the man's hand. (8) The man holds up a promotional trial card and points at the camera, concluding the session in the well-lit store aisle.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male presenter wearing a clean white dress shirt with sleeves rolled up, dark grey trousers, and a black lavalier microphone.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury department store cosmetics floor with polished tile floors, illuminated product counters, and promotional posters for skincare brands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM track and high-energy narration from a male speaker. His pitch is energetic with high variability, signaling excitement. The background contains a faint department store room tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers as the narrator describes the first mask product. The music maintains a steady electronic beat. (3) A conversational segment follows as a second male voice enters; his tone is professional and slightly lower in pitch. Occasional 'laugh track' SFX punctuate the dialogue. (4) A mechanical 'click' and 'hiss' SFX are clearly heard during the rosewater demonstration. The BGM ducks slightly to let the product sounds stand out. (5) The final phase features the lead narrator returning to a high-dominance tone for the call-to-action. The music swells in volume with more synth layers before fading out smoothly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature 1 -> Product Feature 2 -> Product Feature 3 -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional marketing feature for the luxury beauty brand Chantecaille. It utilizes a high-energy influencer to demonstrate key products—a lifting mask, rosewater mist, and foundation—to generate consumer interest and drive traffic to department store counters for a free gift card offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presenter is at a dedicated brand counter, demonstrates specific products with branding, and provides a clear promotional incentive for viewers to visit the store.

high_inference.freeDescribe: Professional beauty vlog with high production value, focusing on product texture and brand experience.
